name: SiteSafetyObservationManager
tagline: Safety observations, corrective actions, toolbox talks and contractor leading indicators – one plug-and-play Power Apps app.
description: A complete construction site safety module for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages. Record positive and unsafe observations, near misses, stop-work events and toolbox talks; drive every corrective action through owner, due date and independent verification; and compare contractors on leading indicators such as positive ratio, overdue actions and observations per 1,000 hours.
features: Six observation types incl. near miss, stop work and toolbox talk
Allowed status transitions and required fields per status
No on-the-spot closing of high-risk items
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset SiteSafetyObservationManager + Power Pages SiteSafetyObservationManagerPortal)
